name: @abijith-suresh/planview
description: Turn an HTML file into a durable, immutable localhost URL.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @planview/local && tsc --project tsconfig.json && node scripts/bundle.mjs && node scripts/make-executable.mjs dist/index.js && npm run build:manager
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @planview/local && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project ui/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck:test && node --test "test/**/*.test.mts"
